title: Psionic pipeline feeding the UAP legacy program

tellings.quote: I was in a you know psionic development uh pipeline for legacy program development

plain: A man named Jordan Jose tells podcast host Jesse Michels that as a child in western New York, around 2008 to 2010, he was placed in what he calls a psionic development pipeline, a path for training mind-based or psychic abilities. He says it fed a long-running secret programme dealing with UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects. If true, it would mean children were being groomed for psychic work tied to UFO secrets.
